notes: A MERGE executed in the range of a MERGE output procedure: "The range of the output procedure shall not cause the execution of any MERGE, RELEASE, or the file format of the SORT statement"; violated, the EC-SORT-MERGE-ACTIVE exception condition is set to exist (§2002:14.8.23.3 GR8; cite.py --check). §2002:14.8.23.2 SR1 forbids a MERGE only in the declaratives, so the program compiles at 2002. EC-SORT-MERGE-ACTIVE is Fatal (§2002 Table 14) and with checking enabled and no applicable USE procedure "execution of the run unit is terminated abnormally" (§2002:14.5.12.1.2 item 4; cite.py --check). The rule makes the results of the operation undefined, not the fatal procedure; there is no 2002 item for a MERGE or SORT statement, so at --std 2002 the guard does not hand the marked condition to the verb: DialectBehavior.SortMergeStatementDisposesItsFatalConditions (VCR row 7.80, kb/Work PB5612).
